! Tier-2 / Tier-3 in-scope sample (no secrets)
hostname R1-BORDER
!
ip access-list extended WEB-IN
 permit tcp any host 192.168.10.10 eq www
 permit tcp any host 192.168.10.10 range 8000 8080
 deny ip any any
!
access-list 10 permit 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255
access-list 10 deny any
access-list 101 permit udp host 10.1.1.1 any eq 53
access-list 101 permit icmp any any
access-list 101 deny tcp 10.2.0.0 0.0.255.255 gt 1023 any lt 1024
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.255.252
 ip access-group 101 in
 ip access-group WEB-IN out
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 1.1.1.1 255.255.255.255
!
router ospf 1
 router-id 1.1.1.1
 network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.3 area 0
 redistribute static subnets metric 20 metric-type 1
 redistribute rip subnets metric 30
!
router rip
 version 2
 no auto-summary
 passive-interface Loopback0
 network 172.16.0.0
 default-information originate
 redistribute connected metric 2
 redistribute ospf 1 metric 5
!
router bgp 65001
 bgp router-id 1.1.1.1
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 remote-as 65002
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 description ISP-A
 neighbor 1.1.1.2 remote-as 65001
 network 192.168.10.0 mask 255.255.255.0
 redistribute static metric 100
!
ntp server 10.9.9.1
logging host 10.9.9.2
logging 10.9.9.3
!
line vty 0 4
 login local
 transport input ssh
!
end
